<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>EXHIBIT 10.70</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>ADDENDUM</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">Made this 6th day of February 2012 (the
&quot;Effective Date&quot;) by and between Viral Genetics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &quot;Company&quot;), and Anthony
Freda, Jr. (&quot;Consultant&quot;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><B>WHEREAS</B> Company and Consultant
are party to a Consulting Agreement dated September 1, 2008 (the &quot;Agreement&quot;) that was extended under an Extension Agreement
dated August 25, 2010 (the &quot;Extension&quot;) in consideration of 1,250,000 shares of common stock of Company (the &quot;Shares&quot;),
and are mutually desirous of clarifying the period of the Extension, and when and how the Services provided thereunder were delivered
and the Shares earned.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><B>NOW, THEREFORE,</B> for good and lawful
consideration and of the mutual covenants contained herein and the mutual benefits to be derived hereunder, the parties agree
as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 17pt; text-align: right">1.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Consultant and Company agree and acknowledge for the sake of clarification that:</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 39pt; text-align: right">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">the Extension was made effective August 25, 2010 and addressed the term of January
1, 2010 through December 31, 2011 (the &quot;Extended Term&quot;), during which Consultant provided the Services;</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 39pt; text-align: right">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the Shares are payable for Services provided during the Extended Term;</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 39pt; text-align: right">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">at all times during the Extended Term, Consultant provided the Services regularly
and on an ongoing basis throughout; and</TD>
</TR></TABLE>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 39pt; text-align: right">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">the Shares payable
                                         for the Services provided during the Extended Term are therefore deemed to have been
                                         earned on a monthly basis<I> </I>with one-twenty-fourth (1/24<SUP>th</SUP>) of the total
                                         Shares due and payable upon the completion of each month of service.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 17pt; text-align: right">2.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">All other terms
and conditions of the Agreement and the Extension shall continue in full force and effect.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><B>AGREED</B> and entered
into as of the date affixed hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>
